overall_summary: Data shows very low view counts overall, but 'self respect' and 'chat/phone micro-interactions' (e.g., pinning, typing, clearing history) marginally outperform other topics like general heartbreak or late-night thoughts. Confidence remains low due to small sample sizes and minimal engagement (likes/comments).

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos focusing on tactile phone actions like clearing storage, keyboard suggestions, or unpinning chats (e.g., rwOUYo_hayQ, AfaLxMy6FMY, djEm2iCAfqw) consistently pull higher baseline views (19-41 views) compared to generic late-night quotes.
winning_patterns.action: Continue focusing on specific, highly relatable digital UI behaviors related to letting go.

weak_patterns.evidence: Topics like 'रात के ख्याल' and open-ended loneliness without a specific tangible trigger (e.g., uIbMpCjVutQ) stagnate at very low views (6 views).
weak_patterns.action: Avoid abstract poetic openings; anchor every story in a grounded, physical everyday object or action.
